auditor_kate: Hi team — auditor preparing SOC2 fieldwork. We need a single, signed artifact proving an emergency RBAC escalation (svc-forensics -> infra-admin) on 2024-09-07 was scoped to CVE triage (ticket SEC-2024-3333). Please include: 1) the exact IAM change events (apply + revert) with eventIDs, 2) KMS operation logs for alias/redwood-forensics-key (keyId=for-9a8b7c6d), 3) the vuln ticket link, 4) PR/approver list that authorized the emergency change, and 5) a short control mapping (which SOC2/ISO controls this exercises). Originals needed for final verification; redacted copies okay for first upload. Can you prepare and post checksums?

rachel_sec: Got it. Change was applied at 2024-09-07T15:11:22Z and reverted at 15:29:03Z. Ticket SEC-2024-3333 contains triage notes. I'll collect CloudTrail JSON for the IAM events and include the eventIDs and actor ARNs.

owen_oncall: I'll pull Splunk snapshots + the GitOps PR (gitops/pr/5890) that triggered it. Splunk query I'm running (will export JSON + redacted images):
```
index=cloudtrail (eventSource=iam.amazonaws.com OR eventSource=kms.amazonaws.com) userIdentity.arn="arn:aws:iam::*:user/svc-forensics" earliest="2024-09-07T15:00:00" latest="2024-09-07T15:45:00"
| table _time, eventID, eventName, awsRegion, requestParameters, responseElements
```
I will place redacted exports in s3://redwood-compliance/redacted/SEC-2024-3333/ and originals in s3://redwood-compliance/originals/SEC-2024-3333/ (origins locked).

infra_bot: Notice: detected gitops/pr/5890 merged 2024-09-07T15:11:20Z; action: RoleBinding svc-forensics -> infra-admin. Revert PR merged 2024-09-07T15:29:01Z.

rachel_sec: KMS activity: GenerateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext at 2024-09-07T15:12:04Z, Decrypt at 15:13:47Z against alias/redwood-forensics-key (keyId=for-9a8b7c6d). I'll include CloudTrail JSON for those calls and a CSV summary by eventID.

auditor_kate: Redacted first is fine. Please include manifest.csv (filename, sha256, eventID, awsRegion), mapping.md (SOC2/ISO controls -> artifact), redaction script, and a note describing the approvals path. Include approvers list and PR merge commit hash. Also HMAC the manifest with the compliance key and post the HMAC value.

owen_oncall: Plan: package redacted artifacts into sec-3333-redacted.tar.gz and upload to s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2024-3333-redacted.tar.gz. Originals gated in originals/ with strict ACL. Will post sha256 + hmac when done.

packager-bot: Reminder: use compliance KMS alias/redwood-compliance-hmac to generate HMAC for manifest; do not include secret keys in the package.

rachel_sec: Timeline to include in mapping.md: 15:05 UTC - vuln reported; 15:09 UTC - emergency PR opened; 15:11:20 UTC - PR merged (bind applied); 15:12-15:14 UTC - forensic decryption actions; 15:28 UTC - triage complete; 15:29:01 UTC - revert PR merged. I'll add the PR approver CSV and the revert commit hash.

owen_oncall: Uploaded redacted package: s3://redwood-compliance/packages/SEC-2024-3333-redacted.tar.gz
sha256: a7d3f1b2c4e5f69807a9b1c2d3e4f5a6b7c8d9e0f1a2b3c4d5e6f7090a1b2c3d
HMAC(manifest): hmac-sha256: 0f1e2d3c4b5a697887766554433221100ffeeddccbbaa99887766554433221199

auditor_kate: Received — thanks. We'll request secure review of originals under NDA; please keep originals ACL locked until reviewer access arranged. Will confirm once we've validated the package. :white_check_mark:
